$comment: Every text a developer reads from the SDKs, in one place (NOC-329). Each entry: its id (<kind>.<name>), its kind (notice, error, or part of an error's message), for a notice or an error its code as RFC 0009 spells it (an error returned with several codes names each, separated by ' | '), the text, with {name} or {name:?} where a value goes, and when it shows. Entries are sorted by id, one field per line, so `git diff` shows each change readably; `pnpm texts` lists what changed since the last release for the owner's review. scripts/texts.mjs generates crates/nocentraldb/src/texts/ from this file and checks it in the gates; run `node scripts/texts.mjs --write` after an edit.

texts.text: the account key cannot be sealed to the invitation's member
texts.when: Account::pair (db.account.pair) when the account key cannot be sealed to the invitation's member key.

texts.text: the account space already records an account key with this number
texts.when: Renewing the account key, on removing a lost member, when the account space already records an account key with the next number.

texts.text: the invitation's agent already has an account: linking an agent is not built yet
texts.when: Account::pair (db.account.pair) with the invitation of an agent that already has an account.

texts.text: the invitation's member is a device of this account already
texts.when: Account::pair (db.account.pair) with the invitation of a device of this account already.

texts.text: the invitation's member is a member of the space already
texts.when: Members::add (members.add) when the invitation's member is a member of the space already.

texts.text: the invitation's certificate does not hold
texts.when: Members::add and Account::pair (members.add, db.account.pair) when the invitation's certificate does not verify, or certifies another member.

texts.text: the invitation's certificate is under an account key its account replaced
texts.when: Members::add (members.add) when the invitation's certificate is under an account key its account has since replaced.

texts.text: the cursor belongs to another model, index or equality prefix
texts.when: A query continued with a cursor of another model, index or equality prefix.

texts.text: the database cannot be opened: another tab holds it, or {error}
texts.when: nc.open in a browser, when OPFS refuses the database: most often another tab holds it; the reason follows.

texts.text: a database name is 1 to 64 characters of a-z, 0-9, - and _
texts.when: nc.open in a browser, when the database name is empty, longer than 64 characters or has another character than a-z, 0-9, - and _.

texts.when: Account::remove_member (db.account.removeMember) when the member to remove is this device.

texts.text: the query does not give one value per field of the index's equality prefix
texts.when: A query that does not give one value per field of the index's equality prefix.

texts.text: the erasure request is another member's
texts.when: Db::erase with a request another member made: only its performer erases with it (NOC-325).

texts.text: the field does not hold {asked}
texts.when: Object::get::<T> when the field holds another kind of value than T.

texts.text: the database was folded by another model than the lock's, and holds no lock to check this one against
texts.when: Opening, when the database holds a view of another model and no lock to check the new one against.

texts.text: an index row has no object
texts.when: A query whose index names an object the view does not hold: the view is damaged.

texts.text: an index that runs in one space is read with space.find, any other with db.find
texts.when: A query of a space-scoped index with db.find, or of any other index with space.find.

texts.text: IndexedDB holds only one of the database's two key records; new keys would open none of its spaces
texts.when: nc.open in a browser when IndexedDB holds only one of the database's two key records, the wrapping key or the wrapped keys.

texts.text: the database exists, but IndexedDB holds no keys for it; new keys would open none of its spaces
texts.when: nc.open in a browser when the database exists on OPFS but IndexedDB holds no keys for it.

texts.text: {what}: {name}{hint}
texts.when: nc.open in a browser, when IndexedDB refuses to open, read, write or use the member's keys: what failed, the browser's error name and a hint.

texts.text: the invitation's member waits to be paired and has no certificate yet
texts.when: Members::add (members.add) with the invitation of a database waiting to be paired, which has no certificate yet.

texts.text: {what}: {error}
texts.when: Opening, when the file system fails on the database's directory, file or key file: what failed, then the system's error, never the path.

texts.text: the key file holds no keys of this SDK's format
texts.when: Opening with a key file (OpenOptions::key_file) whose content is not keys of this SDK's format.

texts.text: the database exists, but its key file does not; new keys would open none of its spaces
texts.when: Opening a database at a path with a key file (OpenOptions::key_file) when the database exists but the key file does not.

texts.text: the key record of the database does not open under its wrapping key
texts.when: nc.open in a browser when the database's key record does not open under its wrapping key.

texts.text: the key record of the database holds no keys of this SDK's format
texts.when: nc.open in a browser when the database's key record holds no keys of this SDK's format.

texts.text: the keystore entry of the database holds no keys of this SDK's format
texts.when: Opening a database at a path when its platform keystore entry holds no keys of this SDK's format.

texts.text: the keystore entry of the database cannot be read
texts.when: Opening a database at a path when its platform keystore entry cannot be read.

texts.text: the keystore failed: {error}
texts.when: Opening a database at a path when the platform keystore fails; its error follows.

texts.text: the database exists, but the keystore holds no keys for it; new keys would open none of its spaces
texts.when: Opening a database at a path when it exists but the platform keystore holds no keys for it.

texts.text: no platform keystore is reachable ({why}); name a key file with key_file(path)
texts.when: Opening a database at a path when no platform keystore is reachable, as on a headless Linux without the Secret Service; a key file (OpenOptions::key_file) is the way out.

texts.text: the space's last admin may not leave it
texts.when: Space::leave (space.leave) when this member is the space's last admin.

texts.text: the space's last admin may not lower its own role

texts.text: the lock is refused: {invalid:?}
texts.when: Opening, when the lock breaks the rules RFC 0005 gives a lock; the core's finding follows.

texts.text: the lock is refused: {error}
texts.when: Opening, when the lock cannot be read; the reason follows.

texts.text: a member does not remove itself: leaving a space is space.leave()
texts.when: Members::remove (members.remove) when the member to remove is this member: leaving is Space::leave.

texts.when: Account::remove_member (db.account.removeMember) while the account space records an account key newer than this device's own: the device takes it when it syncs.

texts.text: this database holds no account key; a device of the account signs off
texts.when: Account::sign_off on a database that holds no account key, an agent's or one waiting to be paired (NOC-325).

texts.text: the device holds no account space
texts.when: Renewing the account key, on removing a lost member, on a device that holds no account space.

texts.text: this browser context has no IndexedDB, which keeps the member's keys
texts.when: nc.open in a browser context without IndexedDB, where the member's keys live.

texts.text: the member is no longer a member of the space
texts.when: A membership call or a write by a member that was removed from the space, or that the relay answered not_member or removed_member for.

texts.text: the field {name} of {collection} has the plugin type {type_id}, rule {rule}, which no plugin given to OpenOptions::plugin implements
texts.when: A write to a plugin field whose plugin type no plugin given to OpenOptions::plugin implements.

texts.text: the account space records no such member of the account
texts.when: Account::remove_member (db.account.removeMember) when the account space records no member of the account with that id.

texts.text: the model has no collection {collection}
texts.when: A read or a write that names a collection the model does not have.

texts.text: the collection {collection} has no field {name}
texts.when: A write that names a field the collection does not have.

texts.text: the object's collection has no field {name}
texts.when: Object::get when the object's collection has no field of that name.

texts.text: the model declares no index {name} of {collection}
texts.when: Db::index (db.index) when the model declares no index of that name on the collection.

texts.text: the model declares no such index
texts.when: A query of an index the model does not declare.

texts.text: the copy holds no object {object} in {collection}
texts.when: An update, a delete or a restore of an object this copy does not hold in that collection.

texts.text: the copy holds no space {space}
texts.when: A call that names a space this database holds no copy of: Space::erasures, Members::list, and every write or read of a space.

texts.text: this browser context has no WebCrypto, which keeps the member's keys
texts.when: nc.open in a browser context without WebCrypto, which wraps the member's keys.

texts.text: IndexedDB holds no wrapping key for the database
texts.when: nc.open in a browser when the database's key record exists but its wrapping key is gone from IndexedDB.

texts.text: the member is not a member of the space
texts.when: Members::remove and Members::set_role (members.remove, members.setRole) when the member id is not a current member of the space.

texts.text: the text is not a pairing answer: {why}
texts.when: Account::complete_pairing (db.account.completePairing) when the text is not a pairing answer; the core's reason follows.

texts.text: the words are no recovery code
texts.when: Account::remove_member (db.account.removeMember) when the words it was given are no recovery code.

texts.text: the text is not an erasure request: {why}
texts.when: Parsing an erasure request from text (ErasureRequest::from_str) when the text is not one; the reason follows (NOC-325).

texts.text: not {name} in {len} lowercase hex digits
texts.when: Parsing an id from text (SpaceId, ObjectId, ChangeId, MemberId) when the text is not that many lowercase hex digits.

texts.text: the text is not an invitation: {why}
texts.when: Parsing an invitation from text (Invitation::from_str; nc.invitation) when the text is not one; the reason follows.

texts.text: the text is not a set of sign-offs: {why}
texts.when: Parsing sign-offs from text (SignOffs::from_str) when the text is not one; the reason follows (NOC-325).

texts.text: this database is not waiting to be paired
texts.when: Account::complete_pairing (db.account.completePairing) on a database not opened for pairing.

texts.text: the object is no person's: it has no personal field
texts.when: Db::erasure_request with an object that has no personal field, so it names no person to erase (NOC-325).

texts.text: a database at a name opens only in a dedicated Web Worker
texts.when: nc.open in a browser, when a database at a name is opened outside a dedicated Web Worker, where OPFS cannot be used.

texts.text: the options name a browser database together with a path, a key file or in_memory(); name one place
texts.when: Opening with options that name a browser database together with a path, a key file or in_memory().

texts.text: the options name both a key file and in_memory(); keys in memory need no file
texts.when: Opening with options that name both a key file and in_memory().

texts.text: the options name no place for the database: call path(dir) or in_memory()
texts.when: Opening with options that name no place: neither a path, nor in_memory(), nor a browser name.

texts.text: the options name both a path and in_memory(); name one
texts.when: Opening with options that name both a path and in_memory().

texts.text: the page size is 0 or above 1000
texts.when: A query whose page size is 0 or above 1000.

texts.text: this database holds no account key, so it pairs nobody
texts.when: Account::pair (db.account.pair) on a database that holds no account key.

texts.text: the invitation asks to be paired as the other kind
texts.when: Account::pair (db.account.pair) when the kind it is given differs from the kind the invitation asks to be paired as.

texts.text: the pairing answer does not hold for this database: {why}
texts.when: Account::complete_pairing (db.account.completePairing) when the answer is not for this database or does not verify; the core's reason follows.

texts.text: a database waiting to be paired creates no space until its pairing completes
texts.when: Spaces::create (db.spaces.create) on a database waiting to be paired.

texts.text: the person's key is not held on this device yet
texts.when: A write of a personal field whose person's key this device does not hold yet: it holds it once it fetched the key's record.

texts.text: the person link {link} of {collection} is unset
texts.when: A write of a personal field whose person link is unset, so the SDK cannot tell whose data it is.

texts.text: the database holds an unreadable plugin state
texts.when: A write to a plugin's field whose stored state the plugin cannot read.

texts.text: the recovery code is not this account's
texts.when: Account::remove_member (db.account.removeMember) when the recovery code given is of another account.

texts.text: the words are not a recovery code: {why}
texts.when: Opening with a recovery code (OpenOptions::recover; nc.open with recover) when the words are not a recovery code; the reason names a word's position, never the word.

texts.text: the database exists: a recovery code recovers the account onto a new one
texts.when: Opening with a recovery code when the database exists: a recovery code recovers the account onto a new database only.

texts.text: the relay no longer serves this member the space {id}
texts.when: A write to a space the relay no longer serves this member: it was removed.

texts.text: the relay URL must start with wss:// or ws://
texts.when: Opening, when the relay URL starts with neither wss:// nor ws://.

texts.text: only a device that holds the account key removes a member of the account
texts.when: Account::remove_member (db.account.removeMember) on a database that holds no account key: only a device of the account removes a member of it.

texts.text: only {role} of the space {doing}
texts.when: A membership call or a write by a member whose role does not allow it: which role is needed, and for what.

texts.text: the member holds no key of a generation the rotation must chain; it rotates once an envelope for it arrives
texts.when: A removal, or an add after a rotation, when this member lacks a key generation the rotation must chain; it works once an envelope for it arrives.

texts.text: the member does not hold a person key of the space, which the rotation must re-wrap; it rotates once it fetched the key's record
texts.when: A removal, or an add after a rotation, when this member lacks a person key of the space that the rotation must re-wrap; it works once it fetched the key's record.

texts.text: a sign-off does not hold for this erasure in its space; nothing was erased
texts.when: Db::erase when one of the sign-offs would not hold in its space by RFC 0008's rules; it writes no shred in any space (NOC-325).

texts.text: the space's clock: {error}
texts.when: A write, when the space's clock cannot be read or written; the error follows.

texts.text: the space {id} is of the model {space_model}, the lock is of the model {lock_model}
texts.when: A write to, or a read of, a space whose model is not the lock's.

texts.text: the account key statement does not verify
texts.when: Members::add (members.add) when the account key statement the invitation carries does not verify.

texts.text: the statement's number is too high
texts.when: Renewing the account key, on removing a lost member, when the account key statement's number cannot grow further.

texts.text: only an admin of the performer's account takes an erasure back
texts.when: Erasures::take_back by a member that is not an admin of the account that performed the erasure (NOC-325).

texts.text: the shred is no provisional erasure of this space that is still pending
texts.when: Erasures::take_back with a shred that is final, already finalized or taken back, or not of the space (NOC-325).

texts.text: the invitation's account is new to this database: pass its fingerprint once a person compared it
texts.when: Members::add (members.add) without a fingerprint when the invitation's account is new to this database; the error carries the fingerprint a person compares.

texts.text: the value does not fit the field {field} of {collection}
texts.when: A write whose value is not of the field's type.

texts.text: the value does not fit the field {field} of {collection}: {why}
texts.when: A write to a plugin's field whose plugin refuses the value; the plugin's reason follows.

texts.text: the local view failed: {error}
texts.when: Any call, when the local view's SQLite fails: storageFull when the disk or the quota is full, storageFailed otherwise; the core's error follows.

texts.text: {what}: {name}
texts.when: nc.open in a browser when WebCrypto fails to make the wrapping key or to seal the key record: what failed, and the name of the error it threw, never a byte.

texts.text: Your account has a new account key. Members that have not learnt it yet still accept the old one.
texts.when: Account::remove_member (db.account.removeMember) returns it once a lost member is removed and the account key renewed. The owner's text, NOC-273.

texts.text: Spaces this database joined before keep its old account. Other members see it as linked to yours.
texts.when: Account::complete_pairing (db.account.completePairing) returns it besides devicePaired or agentPaired when the database had joined spaces under an account of its own, now linked into the one it paired with. The owner's text, NOC-273.

texts.text: Your account is back with a new account key. Your spaces come back when one of their members adds this device.
texts.when: db.account().recovered() gives it on the open that recovered the account from its code (OpenOptions::recover; nc.open with recover), with a new account key on this device. The owner's text, NOC-273; NOC-289.

texts.text: This agent acts for your account in the spaces an admin adds it to. It holds no account key.
texts.when: Account::complete_pairing (db.account.completePairing) returns it on an agent once its account certified it. The owner's text, NOC-273.

texts.text: Your new device was added to this space and reads its whole history.
texts.when: Account::pair (db.account.pair) returns it once per space it added the new device to. The owner's text, NOC-273.

texts.text: This device now holds your account key. Keep your recovery code: it is the way back if you lose every device.
texts.when: Account::complete_pairing (db.account.completePairing) returns it on a device once it holds the account key. The owner's text, NOC-273.

texts.text: The person's personal fields are erased in these spaces. Devices that never come back online, copies made outside the database and unmarked free text keep them; other devices and agents of this account erase only when they run the erasure too.
texts.when: Db::erase returns it with the shreds it wrote, once per call, in every space of the database where a sign-off came for the person's keys. Carsten, 2026-11-15, NOC-326 (Q6).

texts.text: Personal data was erased on a device of this account. The erasure becomes final after 7 days; until then an admin of this account can take it back.
texts.when: No call returns it: the space status gives it with each provisional erasure (provisional_erasures, provisionalErasures), on every device of the account, while an erasure in a space with one account waits out its 7 days. pm's text, NOC-234.

texts.text: The new member reads the whole history of this space.
texts.when: Members::add (members.add in TypeScript) returns it once the member is added to the space: the new member reads every change written before it joined.

texts.text: The removed member keeps its copy of everything it received before now.
texts.when: Members::remove (members.remove) returns it once a member is removed and the space key rotated: the removed member keeps what it already received. RFC 0009's text.

texts.text: A member whose role was lowered keeps its copy of everything it received before now.
texts.when: Members::set_role (members.setRole) returns it on every role change, raised or lowered: a lowered member keeps what it received. The owner's text, NOC-203.

texts.text: This member keeps its copy of everything it received before now. Until an admin rotates the space key, the others write under a key it still holds.
texts.when: Space::leave (space.leave) returns it once this member's removal of itself is written: it keeps its copy, and the space key changes only when an admin rotates. The owner's text, NOC-219.

texts.text: The erasure is taken back in this space, and the person's fields read again; a finalize another device of the account wrote before it saw this take-back still wins, and the person stays erased.
texts.when: space.erasures().take_back(shred) returns it once an admin of the performer's account took a provisional erasure back within its 7 days. pm, NOC-326, on the coding agent's proposal (Q7).
